title: North Korea Launches Missiles Toward the Sea as Pyongyang Protests Against US Claims on Binance Hack
description: North Korea has recently increased missile tests toward the sea amid heightened tensions following US accusations that North Korean hackers were responsible for a major cryptocurrency heist at Binance. Pyongyang denies involvement and protests the US claims, while also signaling reluctance to resume diplomacy. The missile launches appear to be a strategic move to pressure the US amid ongoing geopolitical disputes.
